meta.answer: The number to guess is price.amount, in price.currency.
meta.shownOnCard: Show image, year, and name. Show context so the player knows which price to guess.
meta.imageRule: Images are only used when the artwork is out of copyright in both the US and the EU (artist died 70+ years ago) and the image file is a public-domain or CC0 reproduction verified to show the exact painting that was sold. Items with image null still need an image.
meta.priceRule: price.amount is the nominal price in US dollars at the time of sale, including buyer's premium where the source includes it. approximate=true means the source only gives an estimate.
meta.attributionRule: When imageRights is cc_by or cc_by_sa, show imageCredit, imageLicense (linked to imageLicenseUrl) and a link to imagePage next to the image. cc_by_sa images that are edited must be shared under the same license.
